component.name: Plaitway
component.summary: Several OpenVPN and WireGuard profiles at once
同時使用多個 OpenVPN 與 WireGuard 設定檔

description.p: Plaitway runs OpenVPN and WireGuard profiles side by side. One helper owns the routes and DNS, so profiles do not fight over them, and a network change leaves nothing stale behind.
Plaitway 讓 OpenVPN 與 WireGuard 設定檔同時運作。由一個輔助程式管理路由與 DNS，設定檔不會互相爭奪，網路變更後也不會留下過時的項目。
The app is the window and the tray item of that helper:
這個應用程式是該輔助程式的視窗與系統匣圖示：

ul.li: Connect and disconnect each profile, and see which one holds the internet and which one holds a subnet.
個別連線或中斷每個設定檔，並看出哪一個接管網際網路、哪一個接管子網路。
Edit a profile without showing its keys; secrets appear as placeholders until you ask to see them.
編輯設定檔而不顯示金鑰；機密在你要求顯示之前以預留位置呈現。
Connect on demand while the primary network is Ethernet or Wi-Fi.
主要網路為乙太網路或 Wi-Fi 時自動連線。
Find and remove stale routes, and copy a report for a bug report.
找出並移除過時路由，並拷貝報告以便回報問題。
